fee_notes: Royalty is $997/month flat for first 12 months, then the greater of 5% of Gross Revenue or $997/month. Marketing and Promotion Fund Contribution is currently $500/month flat (not a % of Gross Revenue). Software Reimbursement is currently $400/month (varies; covers POS system software). Technology Fee is currently $0 but franchisor reserves right to charge in future. Local Marketing Expenditure minimum is $500/month (spent locally; only remitted to franchisor if franchisee fails to spend locally). Hold-Over Royalty (after term expiry) is the greater of $2,000/month or 8% of Gross Revenues. Increased Royalty Fee upon uncured default is $2,000/month. Optional Fit Body Boot Camp Elite Mastermind Coaching Fee is $1,297/month. Fit Body Forever Program is mandatory for percentage-based franchisees at no additional fee; existing flat-fee franchisees pay $397/month if they elect to participate. Credit card payment of ongoing fees incurs a 3% processing fee. Transfer fee is $7,500 (or $750 for transfer to wholly-owned entity or heir). Renewal fee is $5,000. Additional Training Fee up to $997/day. Conference Fee currently $1,500 for unlimited tickets (up to $2,000/attendee). Supplier Evaluation Fee $1,500. Administration Fee $500/occurrence. Liquidated Damages equal 3 years of Royalty Fees and Marketing & Promotion Fund Contributions upon franchisor-initiated termination for franchisee default.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty: $997 USD per month for the first 12 months; thereafter the greater of 5% of Gross Revenue or $997 per month. Paid monthly on the 17th day of the month.
Marketing and Promotion Fund Contribution: Currently $500 USD. Paid monthly on the 1st business day of the month.
Software Reimbursement: Varies. Currently $400 USD per month. Paid monthly on the 10th day of each month.
Technology Fee: Our then-current technology fee (Currently, $0). Monthly.
Local Marketing Expenditure Deficiency: $500 per month. Upon demand.
Additional Training Fee: Up to $997 USD (per day). At time of training.
Renewal Fee: $5,000 USD. Upon signing the renewal franchise agreement.
Transfer Fee: $7,500. Before completion of the transfer.
Administration Fee: $500 USD per occurrence.
Interest & Late Payment Penalty: 5% of the delinquent amount plus interest. Immediately upon demand.
Cure Period Extension Fee: $1,000 USD. Upon demand.
Increased Royalty Fee: $2,000 USD per month. Upon demand.
Non-Compliance Fee: Up to $2,000 USD per violation. Upon demand.
Inspection & Compliance Costs and Expenses: Actual costs (estimated at $750 USD per inspection). Upon demand.
Supplier Evaluation Fee: $1,500 USD. Upon submission.
Conference Fee: Currently $1,500 USD for unlimited tickets (up to $2,000 per attendee). Upon registration.
Liquidated Damage Fee: An amount equal to 3 years of Royalty Fees & Marketing & Promotion Fund Contribution. On termination.
Fit Body Forever: No current fee for percentage-based franchisees; $397 per month for existing flat-fee franchisees who elect to participate. Paid monthly on the 24th day of the month.
Fit Body Boot Camp Elite Mastermind Coaching Fee (Optional): $1,297 USD per month. Paid monthly on the 21st day of the month.
Hold-Over Royalty Fee: The greater of $2,000 USD per month, or 8% of Gross Revenues. Paid monthly on the 17th day of the month.
